title: Canonical forgetful comparison for sheaf inverse image, respecting units
statement: Let F:C to D be continuous between sites J and K, E an algebraic target category, and U:E to sets a functor for which sheaf composition is defined on J and K [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction]. Assume left Kan extensions along F opposite exist for E-valued presheaves, weak E-sheafification exists on K, and U preserves these left Kan extensions and K-sheafification. Then the constructed E-sheaf inverse image followed by U is naturally isomorphic to U followed by constructed set-sheaf inverse image. Under this canonical comparison the E-adjunction unit becomes the set-adjunction unit.

source.place: Tag 00YV, lemma-morphism-of-sites-algebraic-structures; the explicit comparison and unit equations use Mathlib Sites.PreservesSheafification and Functor.KanExtension.Preserves.

proof.text: Write constructed inverse image as left Kan extension followed by sheafification. Commute U with sheafification by the inverse canonical sheafComposeNatIso, then commute U with Kan extension using lanCompIsoOfPreserves and apply set sheafification. Naturality of both comparisons proves naturality of their composite.

Expand the restricted composite adjunction unit. The defining equation sheafComposeNatTrans_fac cancels the sheafification comparison. Naturality of the set-sheafification unit moves the Kan comparison next to the Kan-extension unit. Its defining equation leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves_hom_fac then gives the set unit. Check the resulting presheaf equality sectionwise through the faithful sheaf-to-presheaf functor.

lean.statement:
theorem sheafPullbackForgetIso_unit (S : Sheaf J E) :
    (sheafCompose J U).map ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous F E J K).unit.app S) ≫
      (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max u v)) J K).map
        ((sheafPullbackForgetIso J K F U).hom.app S) =
      (sheafAdjunctionContinuous F (Type (max u v)) J K).unit.app
        ((sheafCompose J U).obj S)
